detail: Executor-derived, recorded 2026-09-02 during the P2 transcription of the tactic-mainqa-* queue; enters deferred pending author ratification. The doctrine at strategy-graph-native-dispatch.md (~line 3435) says the machine-verifiable / author-required sort 'survives as the frontier entry's lane attribute', but no lane field exists anywhere in the reconciliation machinery: ReconciliationFrontierEntry (packages/intentionsutil/src/frontier-reconciliation.ts, lines 104-120 as of this commit) carries kind, id, subject, detail, criterion and authority only, and GapNoteRecord (packages/intentionsutil/src/gap-notes.ts) has the closed four-key shape {subject, detail, recorded_at, disposed_by}. This transcription therefore encodes the lane by FORM rather than by field: the 15 machine-verifiable nodes' items became deferred-authority functional criteria on their serving strategies, so they surface as unsatisfied-criterion entries; the 12 author-required nodes became gap notes, so they surface as prose-gap entries. That mapping is an executor interpretation of the doctrine, not a ratified reading — the author may overrule it by ratifying a first-class lane field on ReconciliationFrontierEntry (and a carrier for it on both input shapes), in which case the entries transcribed here need a lane value backfilled rather than inferred from their kind.
subject: lane attribute of transcribed mainqa frontier entries is carried by entry form
